title: The Home Co – Pricing System (Production)
intro: Production-grade internal platform to standardize furniture pricing with bilingual PDFs and role-based access.
summary: Next.js + Neon/PostgreSQL + Prisma platform on DigitalOcean (Linux/KDE) with GitHub Actions CI/CD, RBAC/audit trails, resource presets, and daily competitor-price intelligence.
features: Deterministic calculation engine with precedence rules
RBAC (admin, engineers) with audit logs and approvals
Quote lifecycle: draft → finalize → Excel/PDF outputs
CSV/Excel import & export, full backup/restore workflows
Daily competitor price web crawling for Egypt & GCC

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A production-ready internal pricing platform to unify and accelerate furniture cost estimation workflows.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Replace manual, inconsistent workflows with a centralized, auditable, and scalable system for complex pricing rules.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: End-to-end architecture & development; multi-env containerized setup; responsive admin UI; automated backups; resource & project-based pricing enhancements.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Deterministic engine; RBAC & logs; preset import/export; CSV/Excel pipelines; backups; vendor price crawling.

sections.title: Challenges & Solutions
sections.body: Balanced maintainability and scalability with a modular Prisma schema and Next.js API routes; designed a colorful, accessible UI for non-technical staff.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Cut quote preparation from hours to minutes; improved consistency; enabled standardized resources; increased resilience via backups.

sections.title: Future Plans
sections.body: Room- and project-based calculations; richer vendor crawling; management dashboards.

confidentialNotes: Internal system; keep infrastructure details private in public views.
